newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE nearby white sugar extends losses in evening.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE nearby white sugar extends losses in evening.

text.p: London nearby white sugar futures compounded losses, ending at their lows on Monday after following New York lower, dealers said.
"There's been some weakness in New York and I think London is following. I don't think it's any more than that," one trader said, adding that one house was responsible for most of the selling.
Earlier, the focus was on nearby spread activity as commission house players dominated afternoon business.
In London, most active March ended $2.30 easier at its low of $311.80 per tonne. It had earlier touched a high of $315.20.
December also ended off $2.30 at its weakest price of the day of $315.00 after earlier hitting $318.20.
In New York, CSCE spot March was 0.16 cents lower at 10.55 cents per lb at 1840 GMT.
Paris futures also finished weaker with December off $2.20 at $314.80 and March off 50 cents at $314.00.
